questions.q: Recite 71:6 to 7 with one consistent length on every muttasil and munfasil.
questions.a: du'aaa'eee illaa ... fee aadhaanihim: equal lengths.

questions.q: Madd audit (pupil PDF): list ten madd in Nuh 1 to 10 with family and count. Today's rota group recites Nuh 1 to 10.
questions.a: Ten madd correctly named and counted.

questions.q: Extend: find a madd lazim anywhere in Juz' Tabarak.
Stretch: why is «إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ» only two counts but «عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ» (89:25) four or five?
questions.a: Silah sughra has no hamza after it; silah kubra is followed by a hamza.
A) munfasil. The madd letter ends one word; the hamza starts the next.

questions.q: Think again: If one reciter holds every munfasil for four counts and another for five, are both correct?
questions.a: Yes, in Hafs by way of ash-Shatibiyyah both are allowed; what matters is choosing one and keeping it consistent.
